# TinyDecide (vendored)

`tinydecide.js`, `meta.json` and `model.bin` are unmodified copies from
[TheREZOR/TinyDecide](https://huggingface.co/TheREZOR/TinyDecide) at commit
`aa745b73a2db9a43bce731f0e8e5c90a6899fe2c`: the 10.4M-parameter build with 4-bit weights and its
plain JavaScript engine.

Made by REZOR and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (`LICENSE` in this folder).

`SHA256SUMS` holds the checksums of the three files; Keepatch's CI checks them on every change.
To update, download the three files at a new commit, read the diff of `tinydecide.js`, and
rewrite `SHA256SUMS` and the commit above.
